summary.name: App Shopper
summary.one_liner: App Shopper is listed as a genuine site in the awesome-mac list, but the scraped page text is actually a TouchArcade shutdown notice and podcast listing, so its own function is not described.
use_cases: finding app store price tracking tools
discovering mac apps via curated lists
listening to toucharcade show podcast episodes
summary.what_it_does: ["The page text provided is a TouchArcade closure announcement followed by a list of recent TouchArcade Show podcast episodes (#602 to #613) and a controller review and a game interview preview.", "It does not describe what App Shopper does, its features, or its pricing.", "The listing says App Shopper is in the awesome-mac 'Genuine Sites' section, which is the only App Shopper-related information available."]
notable: Page content does not match the App Shopper name; it shows TouchArcade content instead
Page announces TouchArcade is shutting down and moving the podcast to Patreon
caveats: Page text is about TouchArcade, not App Shopper, so App Shopper's features are unverified
TouchArcade site is closing according to the page
